blocking_findings.finding: R2 correctly records each previous R3 prediction hash beside the newly collected NPY hash, but then requires every pair to be bitwise equal for terminal.complete. The requested contract explicitly says not to assume a historical NPY hash is reproducible across devices; equality/difference is a diagnostic, while each fresh result must bind to its own full SHA, sidecar, checkpoint, shape/order and finite scan.
blocking_findings.consequence: A valid finite export with complete per-file hashes and correct checkpoint/data identity can be marked failed solely because its historical GPU output differs at the byte level.
blocking_findings.smallest_fix: In a new packet identity, retain the expected/collected/match map before terminal inventory serialization, but let completion depend on successful fresh exports, finite/header/sidecar validation, complete six-file collection and fresh-source-to-collected hash equality. Do not gate completion on match to the historical prediction hash.
